prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, face, expression, hair, clothing and jewelry reference, Marta Buhyl. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, actual feline anatomy, clean contained bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, green eyes, long wavy hair, neutral smile or blue turtleneck. This is a different person.
Primary request: reimagine the woman in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve her softly elongated oval face with a delicate narrower chin, broad high forehead, medium brown gently arched eyebrows, light gray-blue eyes and their original spacing, softly defined cheeks, small relaxed slightly parted lips and calm thoughtful expression. Preserve the source's subtle head angle and direct upward-level gaze rather than adding a large grin. Keep natural young-adult proportions and her original appearance without exaggerated large eyes or glamour makeup. Real short soft feline muzzle, small elegant feline nose and delicate whiskers; muted warm sandy/taupe fur with cream cheek and muzzle highlights.
Hair: straight natural medium/light brown with warm dark-blond highlights, just past shoulder length, swept from a side part, one side softly tucked back and smooth lengths over the shoulders, matching the source. No long waves, full bangs or short chin bob.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL, on TOP of the head, both fully visible inside the canvas with ample clear margin. Eye-level sides of the head are continuous hair/fur: NO human ears, extra side ears, lower ears or fleshy lobes. Omit earrings if keeping them would introduce a human ear.
Clothing and jewelry: fully clothed white linen/cotton blouse with long sleeves and a modest V-shaped opening bordered by the distinctive white layered ruffles on both sides of the front placket, as in image 1. Preserve the short delicate white daisy/beaded choker and the second thin silver chain with a small pendant. Keep neckline and chest modestly covered by the blouse. Omit the cream shoulder-bag strap and all logos.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, smooth hair, white ruffled linen and jewelry, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights, matching the existing cat character series.
Composition: square canvas, one centered head-and-upper-torso bust, near-frontal with a subtle natural head tilt from image 1, natural rounded lower shoulder silhouette, head, hair and both ears fully contained with generous transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the stone wall, leaves and all scenery. No other people, props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
